description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'EmployeeDirectorySearchFilterParams' used for filtering search parameters in the Employee Directory feature of the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and provides properties for employee numbers, name or ID, job title ID, and location ID, along with corresponding getters and setters.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectorySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating filter parameters for searching employees in the directory. It includes properties for employee numbers, name or ID, job title ID, and location ID, with default sorting by last name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the filter parameters, setting the default sort field to 'employee.lastName'.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: getNameOrId
methods.description: Returns the name or ID used as a search filter.

methods.name: setNameOrId
methods.description: Sets the name or ID for the search filter.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Retrieves the job title ID filter.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter.
